// Generated from bejamas-juno style registry. Do not edit packages/ui/src/components/pagination/Pagination.astro directly.
/**
 * @component Pagination
 * @title Pagination
 * @description Page navigation with previous, next, first and last links, numbered pages and an ellipsis for skipped ranges.
 *
 * @preview
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href="#" /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" isActive>2</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationEllipsis /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationNext href="#" /></PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 *
 * @usage
 *
 * ```astro nocollapse
 * ---
 * import {
 *   Pagination,
 *   PaginationContent,
 *   PaginationEllipsis,
 *   PaginationItem,
 *   PaginationLink,
 *   PaginationNext,
 *   PaginationPrevious,
 * } from '@bejamas/ui/components/pagination';
 * ---
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationPrevious href="?page=1" />
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationLink href="?page=1">1</PaginationLink>
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationLink href="?page=2" isActive>2</PaginationLink>
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationLink href="?page=3">3</PaginationLink>
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationEllipsis />
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationNext href="?page=3" />
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 * ```
 *
 * ## Rendering pages
 *
 * Pagination is plain links and ships no JavaScript. Work out the pages on the server and map them to items:
 *
 * ```astro nocollapse
 * ---
 * const current = Number(Astro.url.searchParams.get('page') ?? 1);
 * const total = 10;
 * const pages = [...new Set([1, current - 1, current, current + 1, total])]
 *   .filter((page) => page >= 1 && page <= total)
 *   .sort((a, b) => a - b);
 * ---
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationPrevious href={`?page=${current - 1}`} disabled={current === 1} />
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *     {pages.map((page, index) => (
 *       <>
 *         {index > 0 && page - pages[index - 1] > 1 && (
 *           <PaginationItem><PaginationEllipsis /></PaginationItem>
 *         )}
 *         <PaginationItem>
 *           <PaginationLink href={`?page=${page}`} isActive={page === current}>{page}</PaginationLink>
 *         </PaginationItem>
 *       </>
 *     ))}
 *     <PaginationItem>
 *       <PaginationNext href={`?page=${current + 1}`} disabled={current === total} />
 *     </PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 * ```
 *
 * @examples
 *
 * ### First and last
 *
 * `PaginationFirst` and `PaginationLast` jump to either end. Pass `disabled` to the controls that lead nowhere; they render without an `href` and with `aria-disabled="true"`.
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationFirst href="#" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href="#" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" isActive>1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">2</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationEllipsis /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">10</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationNext href="#" /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLast href="#" /></PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 *
 * ### Icon only
 *
 * Set `text=""` on the previous, next, first and last controls to render square icon buttons. Their `aria-label` still names the destination.
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationFirst href="#" text="" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href="#" text="" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" isActive>1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">2</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationEllipsis /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">10</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationNext href="#" text="" /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLast href="#" text="" /></PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 *
 * ### Outlined
 *
 * `variant` overrides the default `ghost` (inactive) and `outline` (active) button variants.
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationFirst href="#" text="" variant="outline" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href="#" text="" variant="outline" disabled /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" variant="default" isActive>1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" variant="outline">2</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" variant="outline">3</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationEllipsis /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" variant="outline">10</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationNext href="#" text="" variant="outline" /></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLast href="#" text="" variant="outline" /></PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 *
 * ### Simple
 *
 * <Pagination>
 *   <PaginationContent>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" isActive>2</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">4</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *     <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#">5</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
 *   </PaginationContent>
 * </Pagination>
 *
 * @api
 *
 * ### Parts
 *
 * | Part | Element | Description |
 * |------|---------|-------------|
 * | `Pagination` | `<nav>` | Landmark with `aria-label="pagination"` |
 * | `PaginationContent` | `<ul>` | Row of items |
 * | `PaginationItem` | `<li>` | Wraps one link or the ellipsis |
 * | `PaginationLink` | `<a>` | A page link, styled as a `Button` |
 * | `PaginationPrevious`, `PaginationNext` | `<a>` | Adjacent page links with a chevron and a label |
 * | `PaginationFirst`, `PaginationLast` | `<a>` | First and last page links with a double chevron and a label |
 * | `PaginationEllipsis` | `<span>` | Marks a skipped range of pages |
 *
 * ### PaginationLink
 *
 * `PaginationPrevious`, `PaginationNext`, `PaginationFirst` and `PaginationLast` take the same props.
 *
 * | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
 * |------|------|---------|-------------|
 * | `href` | `string` | | Page URL |
 * | `isActive` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the current page with `aria-current="page"` |
 * | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Drops the `href` and sets `aria-disabled="true"` |
 * | `size` | `"default" \| "sm" \| "lg" \| "icon" \| "icon-sm" \| "icon-lg"` | `"icon"` | Button size |
 * | `variant` | `"default" \| "outline" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "destructive" \| "link"` | `"outline"` when active, `"ghost"` otherwise | Button variant |
 *
 * ### PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, PaginationFirst, PaginationLast
 *
 * | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
 * |------|------|---------|-------------|
 * | `text` | `string` | `"Previous"`, `"Next"`, `"First"`, `"Last"` | Visible label, hidden below the `sm` breakpoint. Pass `""` for an icon-only control |
 * | `aria-label` | `string` | `"Go to previous page"`, `"Go to next page"`, `"Go to first page"`, `"Go to last page"` | Accessible name |
 * | `size` | Button size | `"default"`, or `"icon"` when `text` is empty | Button size |
 *
 * ### Accessibility
 *
 * - The root is a `<nav>` landmark labelled `pagination`.
 * - The current page link has `aria-current="page"`, so screen readers announce it as the current page.
 * - Previous, next, first and last links have an `aria-label` that names their destination.
 * - Disabled controls have no `href`, so they are skipped by the keyboard, and `aria-disabled="true"` for assistive technology.
 * - The ellipsis is hidden from assistive technology.
 *
 * ### Keyboard
 *
 * Every page is a native link, so no script is needed.
 *
 * | Key | Action |
 * |-----|--------|
 * | `Tab` / `Shift` + `Tab` | Move focus to the next / previous link |
 * | `Enter` | Follow the focused link |
 *
 * ### Data Attributes
 *
 * | Attribute | Element | Description |
 * |-----------|---------|-------------|
 * | `data-active` | link | `"true"` on the current page, `"false"` otherwise |
 * | `aria-current` | link | `"page"` on the current page |
 * | `aria-disabled` | link | `"true"` when `disabled` |
 */

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";

interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<"nav"> {
  class?: string;
}

const {
  class: className = "",
  ...rest
} = Astro.props as Props;
---

<nav
  aria-label="pagination"
  {...rest}
  data-slot="pagination"
  class={cn("mx-auto flex w-full justify-center", className)}
>
  <slot />
</nav>
